name: NeroPAY Payment Gateway
author: NeroPAY

sections.description:
The NeroPAY Payment Gateway plugin allows merchants to integrate NeroPAY into their WooCommerce-enabled WordPress websites effortlessly. With this plugin, you can accept payments securely and provide a seamless checkout experience for your customers.

NeroPAY is a trusted payment provider offering low transaction fees, fast settlement times, and robust fraud prevention tools. Whether you’re operating a small business or a large enterprise, NeroPAY ensures your payment processing is reliable and efficient.

Key Features:
* Easy integration with WooCommerce.
* Secure payment processing through NeroPAY.
* Fast settlement times.
* Low transaction fees.
* Comprehensive reporting and analytics.
* Supports multiple currencies.

To get started, you’ll need a NeroPAY merchant account. Sign up today at NeroPAY and unlock the power of seamless payments for your business.

Notes

NeroPAY is committed to providing top-tier payment solutions. For more details and support, visit our Help Centre or contact our team at hello@neropay.co.uk.

External services

This plugin connects to the NeroPAY API to initiate and verify payments.

It sends the order identifier, total amount, and customer details (name, email, phone, address) when initiating a payment and on payment confirmation (IPN callback).

The API service is provided by NeroPAY.

Terms of Service: https://neropay.app/legal
Privacy Policy: https://neropay.app/legal
sections.installation:
1. Download and Install

    • Download the NeroPAY plugin from this repository or the WordPress Plugin Directory.
    • Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
    • Navigate to Plugins > Add New and click on Upload Plugin.
    • Select the downloaded plugin zip file and click Install Now.

  2. Activate Plugin

    • Once installed, click Activate Plugin to enable NeroPAY on your site.

  3. Configure Settings

    • Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments.
    • Select NeroPAY and click Set Up.
    • Enter your NeroPAY API credentials (available in your NeroPAY merchant dashboard).
    • Save changes to enable the payment gateway.
sections.faq:
How do I create a NeroPAY account?

Visit NeroPAY and click on “Sign Up”. Follow the steps to create your merchant account and obtain your API credentials.

Is the plugin compatible with all WordPress themes?

Yes, the NeroPAY plugin is designed to work with any WooCommerce-compatible WordPress theme.

What payment methods does NeroPAY support?

NeroPAY supports a wide range of payment methods, including credit/debit cards and local payment options. Please check the NeroPAY website for a full list.

Is technical support available?

Yes, our support team is here to help. Please contact us at hello@neropay.co.uk for any assistance.
